responsibility: Defines the central public interfaces, enums, inline helpers, and core data structures shared across the tree vectorizer implementation. It declares statement and SLP metadata types, def/use and reduction classifications, cost-record structures, permutation and pattern-matcher abstractions, and numerous utility predicates for vectorization analysis, making it the main cross-file contract used by tree-vect-loop, tree-vect-stmts, tree-vect-data-refs, tree-vect-patterns, and tree-vect-slp.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared declarations, enums, data structures, and inline utility predicates used throughout the tree vectorizer subsystem, serving as the public contract included by tree-vect-* files; unlike tree-vectorizer.cc, it does not contain the pass-driver orchestration, global-state definitions, or non-inline cost/dump implementations.
